name: Distribution into strength
note: The OHLCV signature of contrarian short flow from Diether, Lee & Werner: a run-up over the prior `lookback` bars, then a heavy-volume bar that makes a new high, closes below its open, and settles in the bottom clv_max of its own range. Short only. The paper's +3% weekly advance is stated in percent of a DAILY bar; here it is carried across timeframes as a multiple of ATR, which keeps 'has advanced meaningfully' the same statement on 1-minute and daily bars instead of a threshold no intraday bar reaches. Every other condition is the rule verbatim.
source: Diether, Lee & Werner (2009), 'Short-Sale Strategies and Return Predictability', Review of Financial Studies 22(2), 575-607 - full text read at https://scholarsarchive.byu.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=10102&context=facpub, where relss_t is defined as shorted shares divided by traded shares on day t and the contrarian-then-predictive pattern is shown in their Table 3. Complementary magnitude from Boehmer, Jones & Zhang (2008), 'Which Shorts Are Informed?', Journal of Finance 63(2) - abstract via the OpenAlex works API. The OHLCV bar signature is my own proxy for their short-volume measure, stated explicitly as a proxy.
